mira (partnerships): Nimbus asked to accelerate marketplace listing. Legal flagged SCIM mapping, KMS custody, and HSM attestation as blockers. Can security/eng confirm gating items? cc @ben

ben (security): Short list: 1) KMS custody model doc (BYOK vs Redwood-managed) + sample IAM policy, 2) SCIM attribute mapping + sample payload, 3) HSM attestation (module cert + firmware sig). I can draft KMS/ liability blurb.

alex (eng): Tech needs: connector type (PKCS11 vs REST), supported algs (RSA-PSS, ECDSA), signing latency targets. For BYOK remote sign, need latency validation on staging.

mira (partnerships): Legal also wants a brief rotation runbook and incident contact list in the partner packet.

ben (security): Rotation summary: partner generates new key -> provide public key/external ref -> Redwood registers external key -> route to canary -> promote after 30m monitoring. Rollback on error spikes.

jordan (platform): CI/CD scoping: require service principal with least privilege (partners:onboard:write, provisioning:read). Nimbus gave wide-scoped token; insist on scoped token.

onboard-bot: Attached -> https://redwood.internal/partners/checklists/nimbus-quick-gate (access: partnerships,security,legal) :white_check_mark:

ben (security): SCIM sample: {"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"userName":"alice@nimbus.co","externalId":"nimbus-id:org-123"}. Groups -> groups.displayName. If no externalId, prefix with `nimbus-id:`.

mira (partnerships): Nimbus asks for staging account to capture SCIM screenshots. Can platform spin one up?

jordan (platform): Yes—14d TTL tenant, name partner-staging-nimbus-<ts>, scoped API key. Need PR for terraform to grant provisioning.write only.

alex (eng): I'll add curl examples and a short smoke test checklist tonight. Example SCIM create curl will be provided.

ben (security): Final: without HSM attestation (FIPS/module cert + firmware sig) we can't approve BYOK for prod.

mira (partnerships): Thanks. I'll contact Nimbus legal/ops for attestation and staging admin. If items not green by Friday EOD, we'll delay listing. Sync tomorrow 9am if open items remain. :calendar:
